name: ascii-image
title: ASCII image
description: Any photo redrawn in live glyphs, with every charset and colour mode, auto levels and a pointer spotlight.

name: ascii-video
title: ASCII video
description: Video, a dropped file or the webcam sampled into glyphs at up to 60 fps, with audio-reactive contrast and jitter.

name: image-compare
title: Image compare
description: A draggable, keyboard-accessible slider between a photo's glyphs and the photo itself, or between two looks.

name: scroll-reveal-image
title: Scroll reveal image
description: A photo that resolves from coarse blocks to fine Braille as it scrolls into view, then fades into the original.

name: ascii-logo
title: ASCII logo
description: An SVG or PNG logo redrawn in crisp glyphs, with shimmer, scan and reveal animations.

name: ascii-globe
title: ASCII globe
description: A lit, rotating planet in glyphs with a day and night terminator, ocean glints, an atmosphere, markers and arcs.

name: world-land
title: World land mask
description: A 3.8 KB land mask of the world from Natural Earth (public domain), shared by the ASCII globe and the dot map.

name: ascii-donut
title: ASCII donut
description: A lit, ray-marched torus spinning in glyphs, with specular highlights, a rim light and drag to spin.

name: ascii-orb
title: ASCII orb
description: A glyph orb for voice interfaces that breathes when idle, listens and speaks, driven by a microphone or your audio.
